notes: This contract pins one bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 Object Class Table cross-field preflight: when a composed object attribute explicitly has sharing Neither and supplies Value Required, Value Required must be false. The official DIF and FDD schemas keep both fields optional in a partial row, so Umbra preserves an omitted Value Required field rather than manufacturing a default. It does not infer any rule for Publish, Subscribe, or PublishSubscribe, model federate publication state, or claim runtime/public-service evidence. The immutable Requirements Lab candidate exports broad clause-4 metadata despite its Table 10 context; RL-052 records that provenance limit. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance claim.
